statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator generates extension encryption tables using its 0xA4 register bytes starting at offset 0x40 when a host writes to offset 0x4C, and marks subsequent extension communication encrypted. This identifies an additional key-setup transition in an independent compatibility implementation; the table algorithm and retail behavior still require separate inspection/corroboration.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical Wii extension revision not established
applicability.scope: 0xA4 register write handler lines 437-440; raw key material and implementation source code are not included.
